observations: Chase 1 holds 17 crates + 2 C and no explosives; the free section holds 23 crates incl. all 3 TNT, the first Nitro, the only Aku, the ! group and the bonus; chase 2 holds 4 crates but 3 Nitros.
Chase crates sit at landings (after the log, at the foot of drops) and work as snags; the guide says spin through or ignore.
The chaser smashes and credits missed crates, so the all-box goal never forces a risky stop in a chase; the Aku must be broken by Crash, so it sits in the free section.
The start trio triggers the chase: the player stops to smash it and the dinosaur bursts out behind him.
Checkpoints mark mode changes: C1 breather in chase 1, C19 ends it, C28 after the explosives, C58 at the drop that starts chase 2.
Explosive teaching order: TNT single, TNT 2-stack, Nitro inside a normal group, Nitro lane line in a chase, green ! at the exit.
Time Trial re-uses three ordinary crate positions as Aku crates so a clean run is invincible for the grass/magma strip.
The red-gem secret course has no crates; the all-box total is independent of it.
Bonus centrepiece: the tool (arrow) is on top of the stack you must dismantle.
badgeConvention: ttBadges: red 1 / blue 2 / green 3 = time-stop crate seconds in time trial; A = crate that is an Aku crate in time trial. Drawn icon = normal-mode type. Key 'wood?' = a counted crate whose type cannot be read (gutter blur or hidden behind a badge)
countingRule: F3 cumulative counts include the checkpoint crate; 'NN (MM)' = without (with) Nitro. After the green ! all 4 Nitro count. Steel !, green !, steel platform and steel C-blocks are not boxes: listed under 'uncounted' (count 0). The bonus (14) is inside the C58 count.
